answer: Proof of Stake serves as a foundational basalt layer for Sybil resistance in AI agent economies. By requiring capital commitment to participate, the network forces adversaries to embark on a costly financial voyage to acquire influence. The cost of an attack scales proportionally with the total value locked, ensuring that an attacker attempting to flood the ocean of nodes faces prohibitive expenditures, effectively pricing out fake identities through the inherent scarcity of staked collateral.
